description: REVTeX 4.2 (4.2f, June 2022, CTAN/MiKTeX package revtex) with its AIP substyle aip4-2.rtx for J. Chem. Phys. (jcp), in the two-column reprint format. aip picks the society and jcp the journal (superscript numbered citations, aipnum4-2.bst). reprint is set explicitly because AIP's default, unlike APS's, is preprint (one column, 12pt). Its preamble takes four of revtex4-2-aps.json's lines, since aip runs the same revtex4-2.cls code (fix-notes, batch 1 round 3): the float end ltxgrid needs (LTXGRID-FLOAT), the title kept from the preamble (REVTEX-TITLE), \@mkpream@relax relaxing \@endpbox (CLASS1-4; needed once CP-1 lifted the profile's array and tabularx refusals, or array tables stop with Extra \or) and the contents names (ABS-7). nofootinbib prints footnotes on the page, as aps.json does: in the first batch 2 run aip's footnotes in the bibliography gave "no bbl" (3,443 branches) and \ltx@xfootnote errors in \spewnotes (1,448), and 6,510 shared branches failed under aip only. With page footnotes the preamble also takes aps's \make@footnotetext line (CLASS1-3). Under aip, revtex4-2's \@makefntext takes its argument without \long, so with page footnotes a footnote of two paragraphs stopped at "Paragraph ended before \@makefntext was complete"; the line after the footnote line redefines it with the same body as \long (probe run 41946956667: 2 errors without it, 0 with it).
